lesson.title: Writing Task 1: transfer practice and editing

learning_objectives.en: Apply the structure to an unseen table and correct inaccurate comparisons.
learning_objectives.vi: Áp dụng cho bảng mới và sửa diễn đạt thiếu chính xác.

strategies.en: Plan an unseen table from scratch; write a separate overview before adding supporting figures. Re-read for fabricated reasons.
strategies.vi: Lập dàn ý bảng mới từ đầu; viết overview riêng trước khi thêm số liệu; rà nguyên nhân tự suy đoán.

common_mistakes.wrong: I think the graph is very good.
common_mistakes.correct: Overall, the largest figure was recorded in the northern district.

reason.en: Task 1 requires reporting data, not personal judgement.
reason.vi: Task 1 phải mô tả số liệu, không bình luận cảm tính.

mini_review.en: Can I state one trend without any invented cause?
mini_review.vi: Tôi có viết được một xu hướng mà không tự thêm nguyên nhân?

visuals.title: Households within a ten-minute walk of a park

instruction.en: Analyse an original table and identify main comparisons.
instruction.vi: Phân tích bảng số liệu gốc và rút ra so sánh.

questions.prompt_en: Which district had the lowest share in 2010?
questions.prompt_vi: Khu nào có tỷ lệ thấp nhất năm 2010?

questions.prompt_en: Which district rose the most in percentage points?
questions.prompt_vi: Khu nào tăng nhiều điểm phần trăm nhất?

questions.prompt_en: Which district had the highest value in 2025?

questions.prompt_vi: Tổng quan nào được số liệu hỗ trợ?
options: All districts increased, with Riverside highest in both years.
The smallest district had fewer than 100 homes.

accepted: All districts increased, with Riverside highest in both years.

questions.explanation_en: Every row rises from 2010 to 2025, while Riverside remains largest.
questions.explanation_vi: Mọi khu đều tăng và Riverside luôn có tỷ lệ cao nhất.

instruction.en: Write a new response to W-ACCESS-02.
instruction.vi: Viết bài mới theo bảng W-ACCESS-02.

questions.prompt_en: Describe W-ACCESS-02 in at least 150 words; give an overview and comparisons.
questions.prompt_vi: Viết tối thiểu 150 từ về bảng W-ACCESS-02; cần tổng quan và so sánh.

answer.model_en: The table compares the proportions of households within a ten-minute walk of a park in three fictional districts in 2010 and 2025. Overall, access improved in every district, and Riverside recorded the highest figure in both years. Northbank experienced the largest increase. In 2010, Riverside led at 66%, whereas Northbank and Hillview stood at 42% and 35%, respectively. By 2025, the shares had risen to 78% in Riverside, 71% in Northbank and 59% in Hillview. The gain in Northbank was 29 percentage points, compared with 24 in Hillview and only 12 in Riverside. Although Hillview remained the district with the lowest proportion, its figure rose substantially over the period. The gap between Riverside and Northbank narrowed from 24 to seven percentage points, suggesting that their levels of access had become more similar by the final year. Meanwhile, Riverside had the smallest improvement despite maintaining the highest access rate. This comparison highlights the distinction between the final level and the amount of change.
answer.model_vi: Riverside cao nhất cả hai năm; Northbank tăng nhiều nhất 29 điểm; Hillview thấp nhất.

questions.explanation_en: The model correctly identifies increases across all districts, the highest district and largest gain.
questions.explanation_vi: Bài mẫu nhận diện tất cả khu tăng, khu cao nhất và khu tăng nhiều nhất.
